name: Proximity Scale Grid
description: Icon tiles swell and brighten by how close they are to the cursor — distance mapped to 0..1 with gsap.utils.mapRange — then settle back with an elastic ripple.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Proximity scale grid
a11y: Tiles are presentational; put real controls inside if needed. Effect is pointer-only (off on touch) and disabled under reduced motion.
perf: One overwrite:true tween per tile per pointermove; transforms + filter only.
prompt: Build a proximity grid: on pointermove over the grid, for every tile compute distance from its center to the pointer with Math.hypot, map it with gsap.utils.mapRange(0, radius, 1, 0) and clamp to 0..1 (p), then gsap.to(tile, { scale: 1 + (maxScale−1)·p, filter: brightness(1+p·.25), zIndex: p·10, duration .35, ease power2.out, overwrite: true }). On pointerleave tween all back to 1 with elastic.out(1,.5) and stagger from center. Skip for touch and reduced motion.

name: Flair Cursor Trail
description: Every few pixels of pointer travel a sprite (emoji, star, shape) pops out, flies in the direction you moved, spins and falls with gravity, then disappears.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Cursor Trail
a11y: Sprites are aria-hidden and pointer-events:none; nothing spawns under reduced motion.
perf: Spawns are distance-throttled (spacing) and removed on complete; transforms only.
prompt: Create a flair trail container: on pointermove, when the pointer has moved ≥ spacing px since the last spawn, append an absolutely positioned span with the next sprite at the pointer, then a GSAP timeline: scale 0→random(.8,1.4) back.out(3); x += dx·2.5 (power2.out) and y += dy·1.5 + 140 (power2.in) in parallel over 1.2s so it arcs and falls; spin += random(±360); fade out from .8s; remove on complete.

name: Hover Image Preview List
description: Agency project index: hovering a row reveals its image in a card that trails the cursor, tilts with your speed and clip-reveals between projects.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Cursor-Tracking Image Preview
Awwwards studio sites
a11y: Rows are real links; focus also reveals the preview; image is decorative (aria-hidden). Reduced motion keeps the list behaviour without the floating card.
perf: gsap.quickTo for x/y/rotation (no new tweens per move); images stacked and clip-revealed.
prompt: Build a project list with a cursor-following preview: a 160×192 rounded card absolutely positioned (xPercent/yPercent −50) moved by gsap.quickTo(x/y, .5s power3) to the pointer and quickTo(rotation) = clamp(±12, Δx·.6). Row enter: card scale 0→1 back.out(1.6) and that row's image clipPath inset(100% 0 0 0)→inset(0) + scale 1.3→1 (expo.out); dim other rows to 30%. Leave: scale to 0.

name: 3D Tilt Scene
description: A whole composition rotates toward the cursor in 3D; layers marked with data-depth float at different translateZ so they separate as it tilts.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Cursor-driven perspective tilt
a11y: Purely visual; content stays readable at rest. Off on touch and under reduced motion (layers still keep their depth offsets).
perf: Two quickTo setters on one element; preserve-3d layers.
prompt: Create a tilt scene: wrapper with perspective 1100px, inner stage with transform-style preserve-3d; gsap.set each [data-depth] child to z = depth·30. On pointermove map pointer to −.5..+.5 and quickTo(rotationY)=px·max·2, quickTo(rotationX)=−py·max·2 (.8s power3); reset to 0 on leave.

name: Velocity Skew
description: Images lean with your scroll speed — ScrollTrigger velocity drives a clamped skewY that eases back to straight when you stop.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Velocity Skew
a11y: Skew is decorative; disabled under reduced motion.
perf: One ScrollTrigger + one quickSetter for all items; only a bigger velocity starts a new tween.
props: Content; mark skewing items with data-skew.
prompt: Implement velocity skew: one ScrollTrigger over the section; onUpdate compute s = clamp(±max, self.getVelocity()/−250); if |s| > |proxy.skew| set proxy.skew = s and gsap.to(proxy, { skew: 0, duration .8, ease power3, overwrite: true, onUpdate: () => quickSetter('[data-skew]','skewY','deg')(proxy.skew) }).

name: Scrubbed Bento Gallery
description: A full-bleed hero image shrinks into the centre of a bento grid as you scroll while the other tiles fade in — a Flip layout change scrubbed by ScrollTrigger.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Scrubbed bento gallery
a11y: Images are decorative; reduced motion shows the final grid with no pinning.
perf: One Flip timeline (absolute, scale) driven by a scrubbed ScrollTrigger; sticky pin.
prompt: Build a scroll bento: 260vh section with a sticky 100vh stage holding a 4×3 grid (areas 'a hero hero b' / 'c hero hero d' / 'e f f d'). Flip.getState(cells, {props:'borderRadius'}) in the grid layout, then make the hero absolute inset-0 radius 0 (start layout) and tl = Flip.to(state, { ease: none, absolute, scale, simple }); add a staggered autoAlpha 0→1 for other tiles at .35; attach tl to a ScrollTrigger (top top → bottom bottom, scrub .6).

name: Batch Scroll Reveal
description: Grid items that enter the viewport together animate together — ScrollTrigger.batch groups them so a fast scroll reveals whole rows instead of a long queue.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Stagger items in on scroll
a11y: Content is in the DOM and visible to assistive tech; reduced motion shows everything immediately.
perf: One batched ScrollTrigger set; transforms + opacity.
prompt: Use ScrollTrigger.batch('[data-batch]', { batchMax, start: 'top 92%', onEnter: b => gsap.to(b, { autoAlpha 1, y 0, scale 1, stagger .08, duration .7, power3.out, overwrite }), onLeaveBack: b => gsap.to(b, { autoAlpha 0, y 60, scale .94, stagger .04 }) }) after gsap.set(items, { autoAlpha 0, y 60, scale .94 }).

name: Scroll Image Sequence
description: Apple-style product spin: a pinned canvas paints frame N of a sequence as you scroll. Works with real frame URLs or a procedural painter.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Image sequence
Apple product pages
a11y: Canvas is aria-hidden; put the message in real text children. Reduced motion shows the last frame, unpinned.
perf: Frames preloaded; tween a { frame } object with snap; repaint only when the frame number changes; DPR capped at 2.
prompt: Create a scroll image sequence: section length·100vh with a sticky canvas; preload frames as Image objects; gsap.to(seq, { frame: frames−1, snap: 'frame', ease: none, scrollTrigger: { start top top, end bottom bottom, scrub .5 }, onUpdate: paint }) where paint draws the frame cover-fitted into a DPR-scaled canvas, only when the frame index changed.

name: Scroll Mask Expand
description: A small rounded window between two words grows to full screen as you scroll, pushing the words apart and zooming the photo out — curtains-open reveal.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Image mask on scroll
a11y: Words are a decorative duplicate (aria-hidden); real heading lives in children. Reduced motion shows the full image.
perf: clip-path + transforms in one scrubbed timeline.
props: Words either side of the window.
prompt: Build a mask expand: 260vh section, sticky stage; image wrapper clipPath inset(38% 39% 38% 39% round 24px) → inset(0 round 0) and image scale 1.5→1 (power2.inOut), left/right words xPercent ∓140 + fade, caption rising at .7 — all in one timeline with scrollTrigger { start top top, end bottom bottom, scrub .6 }.

name: Scroll Spy Rail
description: Long-read layout with a lateral rail: the active chapter highlights as you read, the rail fills with progress, and labels glide you to their section with ScrollTo.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Lateral pin indicator / Scroll waypoints
a11y: Nav is a labelled <nav> with real buttons and aria-current; reduced motion jumps instantly.
perf: One ScrollTrigger per section + one scrubbed scaleY.
prompt: Create a scroll-spy: sticky left nav with a 2px rail whose inner fill scaleY 0→1 is scrubbed by the body's ScrollTrigger (top 50% → bottom 50%); one ScrollTrigger per section (top 50% → bottom 50%) sets the active index onToggle; clicking a label runs gsap.to(scroller, { scrollTo: { y: section, offsetY: 24 }, duration 1, power3.inOut }).

name: Horizontal Text Scroll
description: One giant line of type slides sideways as you scroll down, while each letter drops in, rotates and recolours as it crosses the screen (containerAnimation).
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Horizontal Text
a11y: Text stays a real heading; reduced motion renders it statically.
perf: One x tween + per-char ScrollTriggers using containerAnimation; transforms only.
prompt: Build horizontal text: section length·100vh, sticky stage, nowrap heading with left padding 60vw; move = gsap.to(h, { x: −(scrollWidth − section width), ease none, scrollTrigger scrub }); SplitText chars; for each char gsap.from(c, { yPercent ±120, rotation ±25, opacity 0, color violet, ease back.out(2), scrollTrigger: { trigger: c, containerAnimation: move, start 'left 95%', end 'left 55%', scrub .4 } }).

name: Line Reveal on Scroll
description: Paragraph lines rise out of their masks and un-blur one after another, scrubbed by scroll. Lines re-split automatically on resize so they always match the layout.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Responsive line splits on scroll / Text masking
a11y: SplitText keeps an aria-label with the full text; reduced motion renders plain text.
perf: autoSplit reverts/re-splits on resize and font load; transform + opacity + small blur.
prompt: SplitText.create(el, { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', autoSplit: true, onSplit: self => gsap.from(self.lines, { yPercent 100, opacity .1, filter blur(6px), stagger .15, ease power2.out, scrollTrigger: { trigger el, start 'top 85%', end 'bottom 45%', scrub .6 } }) }) — returning the tween from onSplit lets autoSplit clean it up.

name: Bouncy Footer
description: The footer's top edge is an SVG curve pulled down by your scroll speed as you land, then it springs back like a trampoline.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Footer bounce
a11y: Curve is decorative (aria-hidden); footer content unaffected. Disabled under reduced motion.
perf: Tweens one control-point value and rewrites a tiny path; one ScrollTrigger.
prompt: Add an SVG (viewBox 0 0 100 100, preserveAspectRatio none) above the footer with path M0,100 Q50,100−y 100,100 Z. ScrollTrigger on the footer (top bottom → bottom bottom): onUpdate tween y to clamp(±90, velocity/30) quickly; onLeave/onEnterBack tween y→0 with elastic.out(1,.25) over 1.4s, re-rendering the path on update.

name: Observer Fullscreen Slides
description: Full-screen slides that move one step per wheel flick, swipe or arrow key (GSAP Observer), with a sliding mask, counter-zooming image and rolling title letters. Loops forever.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Infinite looped panels / Observe events
a11y: Focusable region with aria-roledescription carousel; arrow keys work; inactive slides aria-hidden. Reduced motion swaps instantly.
perf: One timeline per transition; input locked while animating.
prompt: Observer.create({ target, type: 'wheel,touch,pointer', wheelSpeed −1, tolerance 12, preventDefault, onUp: next, onDown: prev }). Transition: outer wrapper yPercent 100·dir→0 while inner yPercent −100·dir→0 (sliding mask), image scale 1.4→1, old image yPercent −15·dir, title chars (split once up front) yPercent 120·dir→0 stagger random; ignore input while busy.

name: Infinite Drag Slider
description: Seamless infinite slider — drag or flick it with momentum, snap to cards, use arrows or keys; cards scale and fade by their distance from centre. No cloned slides.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Infinite card slider / Swipe slider
a11y: Focusable carousel region with arrow-key support, labelled prev/next buttons and an index readout; off-centre cards aria-hidden. Reduced motion disables inertia and autoplay.
perf: Every card's x = gsap.utils.wrap of one shared offset; Draggable on an invisible proxy.
prompt: Make an infinite slider: keep one offset; for card i, x = wrap(−total/2, total/2)(i·step + offset); place at center + x with scale 1 − d·.18 and opacity 1 − d·.55 where d = min(1, |x|/(2.2·step)). Draggable.create(proxy, { type: 'x', trigger: root, inertia: true, snap: v => round(v/step)·step, onDrag/onThrowUpdate: offset = proxy.x → layout }). Arrows tween offset by ±step.

name: Cycling Card Stack
description: A fanned deck: drag the top card away (or press Next/Space) and it arcs off then tucks in behind the pile while the rest step forward. Loops forever.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Card stack
a11y: Focusable with Space/→ to advance and a visible Next button; only the top card is exposed to assistive tech.
perf: Positions recomputed from an order array; transforms only.
prompt: Keep order = [indices]; place(pos): y = pos·−14, scale 1 − pos·.06, rotation alternating ±pos·2.5, zIndex n−pos, hide beyond 4. Draggable top card; on release beyond 90px (or Next) tween it x ±260, y −40, rotate ±18, rotate order (first → last), place others (.6s), then send the card behind (zIndex 0) and tween it into the last slot.

name: Flip Filter Grid
description: Filter chips re-arrange a grid with GSAP Flip — survivors glide to their new cells, new items pop in and removed ones shrink away.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Flexbox filtering
a11y: Chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed in a labelled toolbar; reduced motion changes instantly.
perf: Flip.from with absolute + scale; display toggled, no re-render needed.
prompt: On filter click: state = Flip.getState(items); set display none/'' by tag; Flip.from(state, { duration .7, power3.inOut, scale, absolute, stagger .03, onEnter: els => fromTo scale 0→1 back.out, onLeave: els => to scale 0, opacity 0 }).

name: Flip Layout Switch
description: Grid ↔ list ↔ featured toggle: React re-renders with new classes and Flip animates every card and its nested image from the old box to the new one.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Animate CSS grid positions
a11y: Segmented control is a radiogroup with aria-checked; reduced motion swaps instantly.
perf: Flip state captured right before setState, played in useGSAP after commit; nested: true.
prompt: Before setMode, state = Flip.getState('[data-flip], [data-flip-img]') (elements have data-flip-id); after React commits (useGSAP with [mode] dependency) run Flip.from(state, { duration .65, power3.inOut, nested: true, stagger .025 }).

name: Flip Grid Modal
description: Click a thumbnail and the very same image node flies from the grid into a product dialog (Flip), text staggers in; closing flies it back home.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Flip gallery modal / Simple grid Flip modal
a11y: Dialog has role=dialog, aria-modal, focus moves to Close, Esc and backdrop close it.
perf: Single node re-parented; Flip.from with scale.
prompt: On open: state = Flip.getState(thumb); render the dialog; append the thumb into the dialog's slot; Flip.from(state, { duration .7, power3.inOut, scale, zIndex 60 }); stagger the text in. On close: state = getState; append back into its grid button; Flip.from(state, … onComplete: unmount dialog).

name: Ripple Stagger Grid
description: Click any dot and a shock-wave ripples outward from it — GSAP grid stagger from an index — each dot lifting, swelling and recolouring by distance.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Staggering
a11y: Each cell is a labelled button (keyboard-triggerable). Reduced motion: a quick opacity flash.
perf: One timeline with two staggered tweens; transforms + colour.
prompt: gsap.timeline().to(dots, { keyframes: { y: [0,−18,0], scale: [1,1.6,1] }, backgroundColor: i => hsl(250 + col·6 90% 65%), duration .7, stagger: { grid: [rows, cols], from: clickedIndex, amount: 1 } }).to(dots, { backgroundColor: rest, duration .8, stagger: same }, .5).

name: Radial Action Menu
description: A FAB blooms into a ring of actions with a bouncy stagger — and closes with a different, crisp ease instead of replaying the bounce backwards.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Radial Menu / easeReverse
a11y: Toggle has aria-expanded; hidden actions are removed from tab order; each action has a label. Reduced motion places items instantly.
perf: One tween per item; positions precomputed from angle.
prompt: Open: rotate the + icon 135° (back.out), each item fromTo(x0,y0,scale .3,hidden → cos/sin(angle)·radius, scale 1, visible) with back.out(2.2) and i·45ms delay. Close: a separate set of tweens back to center with power3.in, .25s, reversed stagger — different ease for the reverse direction.

name: Interruptible Menu Overlay
description: Full-screen menu as ONE paused timeline — panels wipe down, link letters rise from masks — played forward to open and reversed (faster) to close, so it can be interrupted at any point.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Interruptible single timeline enter/exit
a11y: Toggle has aria-expanded, links leave tab order when closed, Esc closes. Reduced motion: near-instant timeline.
perf: Built once; play/reverse never rebuilds tweens.
prompt: Build tl = timeline({ paused }) .fromTo(panels, { scaleY 0 }, { scaleY 1, origin top, .8s expo.inOut, stagger .08 }) .from(chars (SplitText chars with mask), { yPercent 110, .7s expo.out, stagger .012 }, '−=.35') .from(footer, { autoAlpha 0, y 12 }); open → tl.timeScale(1).play(), close → tl.timeScale(1.8).reverse().

name: Curved Wipe Transition
description: Page transition with a liquid curved wipe: an SVG path bulges up to cover the screen, the content swaps, then it peels away with the opposite bend.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Curve swipe
a11y: Overlay is aria-hidden; nav buttons expose aria-current. Reduced motion swaps content instantly.
perf: attr:{d} tweens on one path; no plugin required.
prompt: Cover: tween path d from 'M0 100 V100 Q50 100 100 100 V100z' → 'M0 100 V50 Q50 0 100 50 V100z' (power3.in) → 'M0 100 V0 Q50 0 100 0 V100z'; swap content; reveal: 'M0 0 V50 Q50 100 100 50 V0z' → 'M0 0 V0 Q50 0 100 0 V0z' (power2.out) while the new screen rises 60px→0.

name: MorphSVG Shape Cycle
description: One SVG path morphs between a blob, star, heart, bolt and drop with an elastic overshoot — MorphSVG matches different point counts automatically.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Morph between SVG shapes / Smooth morph
a11y: SVG has role=img with the current shape as its label; buttons use aria-pressed. Reduced motion: instant shape change, no autoplay.
perf: Single path; morphSVG precomputes the interpolation.
prompt: gsap.to(path, { morphSVG: { shape: next.d, type: 'rotational', shapeIndex: 'auto' }, fill: next.color, duration .9, ease 'elastic.out(1,.6)', overwrite: true }) on a timer and on chip click.

name: Motion Path Waypoints
description: Delivery-tracker route: a marker drives along a winding path to any waypoint (from wherever it is), facing the road, while the travelled route draws itself.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — MotionPath waypoints / Animate along a path
a11y: SVG labelled with the current stop; stops are buttons with aria-pressed and a text detail line. Reduced motion jumps.
perf: motionPath start/end on one marker + one drawSVG tween.
prompt: gsap.to(marker, { motionPath: { path, align: path, alignOrigin [.5,.5], autoRotate: true, start: currentProgress, end: target.at }, duration .6 + |Δ|·2.2, power2.inOut }) together with gsap.to(trail, { drawSVG: `0% ${target.at·100}%` }); position stop circles with path.getPointAtLength(total·at).

name: CustomWiggle Attention
description: Attention micro-interactions with CustomWiggle: a bell that rings, an input error shake, a jelly squash and a nudge — each always returns exactly to rest.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — CustomWiggle
a11y: Wraps your own control; pair the error shake with aria-invalid + message. Reduced motion: a soft opacity pulse.
perf: One tween whose ease is the oscillation.
prompt: Register CustomEase + CustomWiggle. ring: rotation 0→22, origin 50% 8%, ease CustomWiggle.create('ring', { wiggles 7, type easeOut }); shake: x 0→10 uniform 6 wiggles .5s; jelly: scaleX→1.25 and scaleY→.8 easeOut wiggles offset 40ms; nudge: y→−8 anticipate. Fire on click/hover/trigger change.

name: Physics Confetti Cannon
description: Click the button and it fires projectile confetti — Physics2D velocity, angle and gravity so pieces arc and fall naturally while flipping in 3D.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Create physics-based effects
a11y: Pieces are aria-hidden and non-interactive; the wrapped button stays the control. No confetti under reduced motion.
perf: 60 small elements, removed on complete; transforms + opacity.
prompt: For each piece append an absolutely positioned <i> at the button center, then gsap.to(el, { physics2D: { velocity random(320,640), angle angle ± spread/2, gravity 900, friction .03 }, duration 2.2 }) plus random rotationX/rotationY/rotation over 2.2s and fade from 1.6s; remove on complete. Elastic squash on the button.

name: Throwable Sticker Board
description: A desk of polaroids and stickers you can pick up and throw — Draggable with InertiaPlugin keeps momentum, bounds keep them on the board, the held item lifts and tilts.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Make elements draggable / Inertia
a11y: Decorative play surface; don't put essential content only here. Reduced motion keeps drag without inertia or entrance.
perf: Draggable uses transforms; inertia computed once per throw.
prompt: Draggable.create(stickers, { bounds: board, inertia: true, edgeResistance .75, onPress: raise zIndex + scale 1.08 + big shadow, onDrag: rotation = clamp(±25, deltaX·1.5), onRelease: scale 1, random tilt ±12 (back.out) }); entrance: from scale 0, rotation −40 stagger .06.

name: Particle Text Morph
description: Thousands of particles assemble into a word, hold, scatter and re-form into the next — sampled from canvas text, tweened by GSAP, pushed around by your cursor.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Canvas particles
a11y: Canvas is aria-hidden; the current word is announced via a polite sr-only live region. Reduced motion draws the first word statically.
perf: One canvas redrawn on gsap.ticker; particle objects tweened directly (no DOM).
prompt: Sample each word: draw it centered on an offscreen canvas, read alpha every density px into target points. Keep a particle pool; gsap.to(particles, { x: i => target.x, y: i => target.y, a: 1 (0 for extras), duration 1.3, expo.inOut, stagger { amount .6, from random } }); to switch, scatter to random positions (power2.in) then form the next word. Draw all particles each gsap.ticker tick, offsetting those within 70px of the pointer.
